Name: New NPC Sunny 1.6
Author: muxuelaiyin
Description:
[center][/center]你好，这里是狐妖直晴的非官方1.6更新，已获得原作者的授权。
简介：
直晴是一只修炼了四千多年的狐妖，为了继续精进修为而寻找着能帮他突破第二道劫数的人选，经过推算后发现目标正是现在居住在星露谷的你。初见时他总是一副咋咋呼呼、无忧无虑的模样，但是随着和你的关系逐渐熟络，你慢慢发现了他内心中深埋已久的忧虑和迷惘（还有意外粘人和缺乏安全感的一面），究竟是什么样的过去造成了他现在的性格......?
礼物清单：
最爱：海蓝宝石，夏威夷芋泥，琉璃山药，大米布丁，普通蘑菇，绿茶，猫眼石;
喜欢：所有的制作食品，所有宝石，美洲大树莓，香味浆果;
不喜欢：所有资源类，淡啤酒，啤酒;
讨厌：所有动物产品（蛋，奶）法式田螺，生鱼片，joja可乐;
事件触发：
0心——你一出农场就能遇到。
2心——6：00-18：00；星期一，星期天；在图书馆，你会发现正在阅读的直晴。
4心——20：00-晚上2：00;在山上，你会与即将下矿的直晴相遇。
6心——20：00-晚上2：00，在小镇的墓园处，你发现直晴又在那边沉思。
8心——20：00-晚上2：00；下雨，海滩边；直晴似乎有什么话想要对你说。
10心——同时与法师有4颗心的好感度，法师会给你发来一封抱怨信，收到后前往法师塔，你会发现....
14-1心——20：00-晚上2：00;周三和周六，神秘森林；在直晴出门的日子里，你在神秘森林里看到他似乎想着什么事情出了神......
14-2心——12:00-20:00房子升到3级（不需要开地窖），直晴回来后告诉了你一些事情....
14-3心——星期四，晚上20：00-晚上2：00；巴士站；在你回家的路上发现了正在等着你的直晴，他看起来很高兴....
附言：
1、出于技术不足的原因，我将直晴的出生点从秘密森林改到了秘密森林的入口，不然他会一动不动。
2、关于兼容性，我用我囊括了大部分拓展和新NPC的500+MOD的档测了几遍，没有报过错，所以他应该和几乎所有MOD兼容。如果发现了错误，可以在这留言，我有空就会修，但请尽量描述得详细一点，因为我技术很差。
3、如何使用肖像：下载尾号999并放进MOD文件夹，然后从[NPC]Sunny/Assets/Portraits复制Sunny.png，粘贴到Portraiture/Portraits/你新建的任意文件夹，进游戏后按P使用，按O锁定即可。
最后，感谢你的游玩！希望你能喜欢这只狐妖少年。
————————————————————————————————————————————————————————
Here is the English introduction (using translation):
Hello, this is the unofficial 1.6 update of Sunny, which has been authorized by the original author.
Introduction:
Sunny is a fox demon who has been practicing for over 4000 years. In order to continue improving his cultivation, he is looking for someone who can help him break through the second calamity. After calculation, he discovers that his target is you, who currently resides in Xinglu Valley. At first glance, he always looked carefree and carefree, but as our relationship gradually became closer, you gradually discovered the long buried worries and confusion in his heart (as well as his unexpectedly clingy and insecure side). What kind of past has caused his current personality?
Gift List:
Favorite: aquamarine, Hawaiian taro paste, glazed yam, rice pudding, regular mushrooms, green tea, cat's eye stone;
Likes: all made foods, all gems, American raspberries, fragrant berries;
Not liked: all resource categories, light beer, beer;
Disgusting: All animal products (eggs, milk) French snails, sashimi, joja cola;
Event trigger:
Zero Heart - You can meet it as soon as you leave the farm.
2 hearts -6:00-18:00; Monday, Sunday; In the library, you will find Sunny reading.
4 Hearts -20:00-2:00 PM; On the mountain, you will meet Sunny who is about to go down to the mine.
6 Hearts -20:00-2:00 pm, at the cemetery in the small town, you find Sunny lost in thought again.
8 Hearts -20:00-2:00 PM; Rain, by the beach; Sunny seems to have something to say to you.
10 Hearts - At the same time, if you have a favorable impression of 4 hearts with the mage, the mage will send you a complaint letter. After receiving it, go to the mage tower and you will find...
14-1 Heart -20:00-2:00 PM; Wednesday and Saturday, Mysterious Forest; On the days when Sunny went out, you saw him in the mysterious forest, seemingly
thinking that something had gone wrong...
14-2 Heart -12:00-20:00 The house has been upgraded to level 3 (no need to open a cellar), and after Sunny returned, she told you something...
14-3 Heart - Thursday, 20:00-2:00 PM; Bus stop; On your way home, I found Sunny waiting for you, and he looked very happy...
Addendum:
1. Due to technical limitations, I changed Sunny's birthplace from the Secret Forest to the entrance of the Secret Forest, otherwise he would have remained motionless.
2. Regarding compatibility, I tested it several times using the 500+MOD file that includes most of the extensions and new NPCs, and there were no errors reported. Therefore, it should be compatible with almost all MODs. If you find any errors, you can leave a message here and I will fix them when I have time, but please try to describe them in more detail because my skills are very poor.
3. How to use portrait: Download the file ending in 999 and place it in the MOD folder. Then copy Sunny.png from [NPC] Sunny/Assets/Portraits, paste it into Portraiture/Portraits/any folder you create, enter the game and press P to use it, press O to lock it.
Finally, thank you for playing! I hope you like this fox demon boy.
